text:
Alex: Hey team  first day here. Quick org/ownership map request: who do I ask for (1) dataset access for evals, (2) temporary billing credits for experiments, (3) model artifact storage quotas, and (4) fast approvals if something blocks a demo? Also what's the escalation flow if approvals are delayed >24h?

Tanya: welcome Alex! Short answers: datasets -> data-plat, billing credits -> financeops, storage quotas -> eng-infra, demo fast-path -> product-ops + eng-platform.

Brian: adding details: for dataset access include dataset id, purpose, and retention plan. Data-plat reviews compliance + lineage. Example ticket body: `dataset: customer-logs-2025 purpose: evals retention: 30d approver: manager`

Sofia: for billing credits we have a small pool for onboarding/experiments. File a request at https://go/redwood/credits-request and tag `onboard:credits`. FinanceOps aims to approve within 48h; for demos use `fast-path` tag.

Alex: thanks. If billing/credits are stuck for >24h and I have a looming demo how do I escalate?

Tanya: escalation: financeops -> product-ops -> ops-manager. If still unresolved and demo is <6h, product-ops can request an emergency ephemeral grant (24h). Put `onboard:urgent` in the ticket title and DM @Sofia.

escalation-bot: PagerPolicy: onboard-urgent -> #eng-oncall (2m) -> #ops-manager (10m) -> #cto (30m) if marked critical. Use sparingly.

Brian: storage quotas: eng-infra enforces bucket quotas and artifact retention. For larger requests include storage reason, expected size, and TTL. Example: `artifact-store: model-artifacts team: alexlab size: 400GB ttl: 90d` We'll provision or suggest tiered storage.

Sofia: demo fast-path checklist: 1) request credits (tag: fast-path) 2) request env allowlist (eng-infra) 3) sample data provisioning (product-ops) 4) run smoke test 24h before. Template is at https://go/redwood/onboard/demo-fastpath.

Alex: great. One more: who owns the cross-team "who to cc" matrix? I'd like a single page mapping common asks to owners so new hires don't ping the wrong team.

Tanya: product-ops maintains a living who-to-ask page but it's fragmented. I'll create a consolidated page and drop the link here. For now quick map: 
- Dataset access: data-plat (Brian)
- Billing/credits: financeops (Sofia)
- Storage/artifacts: eng-infra
- Demo reserve & fast approvals: product-ops + eng-platform
- Oncall/escalations: eng-sre/ops-manager

Brian: added a ticket template snippet to help: ```component: dataset area: access owner: data-plat contact: @data-plat approver: manager tags: onboard:dataset```

Sofia: I'll also add a note about reasonable timelines (credits ~48h, fast-path aim <6h) so expectations are clear.

Alex: saved all of this, thanks! Tagging thread for my notes :memo:
